issues.detail: The Hebrew says Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Hananiah the prophet, but the Vietnamese says 'Đức Chúa Trời phán cùng Giê-rê-mi' (God spoke to Jeremiah), which reverses the speaker and addressee and introduces God as the speaker, which is not in the Hebrew.
The name 'Hê-nanh' is a garbled rendering of 'Hananiah' (חֲנַנְיָה), which should be 'Ha-na-nia' or similar; the Vietnamese has a distorted name.
